description: Connect GetNote to save ideas and webpages, find notes, read transcripts, and organize knowledge.

display.description_en: Connect GetNote to save ideas and webpages, find notes, read transcripts, and organize knowledge.
display.description_zh: 连接得到大脑与 AI：随手保存文字、网页和图片，语义查找个人笔记，读取录音转写与会议待办，并用标签、文件夹和知识库整理长期信息。
examples_en: Find my notes about user growth and summarize the key takeaways
Save this webpage to GetNote and tag it as Product Ideas
Turn this meeting transcript and action items into concise meeting notes
Create a weekly report from the work notes I saved this week
examples_zh: 找找我之前关于用户增长的笔记，整理出关键结论
把这个网页存进得到大脑，并加上「产品灵感」标签
把这场会议的逐字稿和待办事项整理成一份会议纪要
根据我这周记录的工作笔记，帮我生成一份周报
